title: E2E Pipeline Integration — Print-to-Shipped AGI
brief: Full end-to-end integration: print/description → CAD model (MS0-3) → CAM program (MS4) → optimized G-code (MS6) → adaptive execution (MS5) → shipped part. JM Die 24,545 programs as regression corpus. Target: beat human programmers on 80%+ of real parts on cycle time + quality.

must_include: JM Die print formats (PDF, DWG, STEP, legacy paper)
Feature cascade from MS3 (CAD validation receipt)
Success criteria: 80%+ AGI beats human on cycle time + quality

units.title: PrintToShippedOrchestratorEngine — master pipeline controller
units.intent: Master state machine for print → shipped. Stages: ingest → CAD → validate CAD → CAM plan → post → execute → QA. Each stage has exit gate; failure → automatic replan or human escalation.

loops.loop_1_build: State machine. Stage transitions with gates. Rollback/retry policies. Human-in-loop hooks.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Systems architect + formal methods reviewer. Check: state machine completeness, deadlock freedom.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 10 test parts traverse full pipeline end-to-end with 100% success.

units.description: PrintToShippedOrchestratorEngine — master pipeline controller — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: PrintIngestEngine — PDF/DWG/STEP/text parser
units.intent: Parse all input formats: PDF (OCR + GD&T), DWG/DXF (geometry extraction), STEP/IGES (direct import), text description (NLP via text-to-CAD). Output: unified spec object.

loops.loop_1_build: Format-dispatch parser. PDF: Tesseract + GD&T regex + view recognition. DWG: ODA/LibreDWG. STEP: already supported.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: NLP + drafting expert. Check: GD&T extraction correctness (feedback FCF control frames).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 95%+ spec extraction accuracy on 20 JM Die PDFs + 20 STEP/DWG files.

units.description: PrintIngestEngine — PDF/DWG/STEP/text parser — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: CADCAMHandoffEngine — enforce validation receipt chain
units.intent: CAD model with MS3 validation receipt flows to CAM. CAM refuses without valid receipt. Likewise CAM→Post, Post→Exec. Receipts are HMAC-signed, auditable.

loops.loop_1_build: Receipt data model. HMAC signing. Verification at every handoff. Audit log.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Security reviewer + QA. Check: no bypass, key rotation policy, audit tamper-proof.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Emergency override with manager approval + audit trail.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 100% of handoffs enforce receipt; 0 bypass found in red-team testing.
exit_gate.rollback_procedure: git revert — but pipeline cannot ship without this gate.

units.description: CADCAMHandoffEngine — enforce validation receipt chain — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: OptimalMachineSelectorEngine — shop-floor-aware routing
units.intent: Select optimal machine from 21 JM Die machines given part characteristics. Balance capability, load, operator skill. Can split ops across machines (rough on Okuma, EDM on Mitsubishi).

loops.loop_1_build: Capability matcher. Load-aware (current queue). Multi-op routing.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Shop floor foreman + scheduling expert. Check: load balancing, operator skill alignment.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Emergency re-route on machine down. Cost-optimal split.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Shop foreman agrees with 85%+ machine selections on 30 part samples.

units.description: OptimalMachineSelectorEngine — shop-floor-aware routing — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: JMDieRegressionCorpusEngine — 24,545 program benchmark harness
units.intent: Load full JM Die program corpus as regression harness. For each program: extract original part (STEP/drawing), run AGI pipeline, compare output program vs reference. Metrics: cycle time, tool life, surface finish (predicted), safety.

loops.loop_1_build: Corpus indexer. Reference-program parser. Pipeline invocation harness. Metric comparator.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: ML benchmark engineer + master machinist. Check: metric definitions, fair comparison discipline.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Incremental corpus updates, shadow mode (AGI runs alongside human, no shipping).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Full corpus runs in < 24 hours. Metrics collected for 100% of programs.

units.description: JMDieRegressionCorpusEngine — 24,545 program benchmark harness — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: AGIvsHumanBenchmarkEngine — beat-humans scorecard
units.intent: Scorecard: % of 24,545 programs where AGI output beats or matches human on cycle time AND surface finish AND tool life. Target: >= 80% wins. Publish board-level dashboard.

loops.loop_1_build: Win-condition predicates. Aggregator. Dashboard JSON output.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: ML evaluator + QA. Check: statistical significance (binomial test), corpus balance.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Breakdown by material, operation type, customer.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: AGI wins on >= 80% of representative subset (1,000 programs). Statistically significant (p < 0.01).
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If AGI wins < 60%, do not ship — retrain MS4.
exit_gate.rollback_procedure: git revert. Do not promote AGI to production until >= 80%.

units.description: AGIvsHumanBenchmarkEngine — beat-humans scorecard — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: ShippedPartValidatorEngine — FAI-grade outcome verification
units.intent: After physical part is produced, compare CMM inspection vs CAD model. If out-of-tol, feed back to MS5 (adaptive exec retrain) or MS4 (strategy retrain).

loops.loop_1_build: CMM data ingestion. Feature-by-feature compare. Root-cause analyzer (which stage caused deviation?).
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: FAI expert + AS9102 compliance. Check: measurement traceability, statistical control.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generate AS9102-compliant FAI reports for 10 first-article parts; 100% accepted by JM Die QA.

units.description: ShippedPartValidatorEngine — FAI-grade outcome verification — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MS7 Master Dispatcher + Full System Cascade
units.intent: Wire 7 new engines into master dispatcher. 8 new actions. 8 new skills. Final feature cascade — entire DAGI system operational.

loops.loop_1_build: Full dispatcher assembly. End-to-end test (print → shipped simulated). Master cascade JSON.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Final integration reviewer + master machinist. Check: no gap, all actions routable.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: E2E test with 5 real JM Die prints produces shippable G-code, FAI-passing parts.
